external.title: External automation
external.description: Connect n8n, scripts or AI agents to Athena.
external.webhookHint: Send a POST request to fire a webhook trigger; no sign-in needed. Each webhook trigger has its own token: copy its full URL from the trigger list.
external.mcpHint: Streamable HTTP. Clients sign in with a session cookie, or send the token set in the server's <envVar>ATHENA_MCP_TOKEN</envVar> environment variable as <authHeader>Authorization: Bearer <token></authHeader>.

jobRuns.title: Job runs
jobRuns.description: The latest runs, refreshed every few seconds.

empty.title: No job runs yet
empty.description: Runs show up here when a trigger fires.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: Run an app or package action on a schedule or from a webhook.

empty.title: No triggers yet
empty.description: A trigger runs an action on a schedule (cron) or when its webhook is called, for example from n8n.

triggers.deleteDescription: It stops running. Past job runs stay in the log.
triggers.deleteDescriptionWebhook: It stops running and its webhook URL stops working. Past job runs stay in the log.

dialog.description: Run an app or package action on a schedule, or whenever a webhook is called.

created.title: Webhook trigger created
created.description: Send a POST request to this URL to run "{{name}}". Anyone with the URL can fire it, so keep it private. You can copy it again from the trigger list.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.cronPlaceholder: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 0 2 * * *
dialog.cronHelp: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, weekday. Times are UTC.
dialog.webhookHint: After you create it you get a secret URL. A POST request to it (from n8n, a script or curl) runs the action.
dialog.sourceHint: A Flatpak remote, a Scoop bucket, or "cask" for a Homebrew cask.
dialog.installedFailed: Couldn't list installed packages ({{error}}); type the name.
